shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/monolith bearing a figure in relief
single frontal standing human figure occupying the full height of the slab
figure carved in relief projecting from the slab's face
block/plinth base at the foot of the monument
justification: Both show a single frontal standing human figure carved in relief filling the height of an upright slab set on a base, which is the main correspondence but is a widely independent solution. The depicted content diverges sharply otherwise: A shows an unadorned, naturalistically modelled nude body with no accompanying motifs, while B shows a heavily costumed figure smothered in headdress, masks, ornaments and sign-like panels rendered in dense schematic low relief.
